defect.summary: NautilusTrader BacktestNode cannot read catalog data for instruments whose NT instrument id is non-ASCII. The catalog stores instrument directories URL-encoded (urisafe_instrument_id). For local catalogs, ParquetDataCatalog::from_uri normalizes plain paths to file:// URIs unconditionally (crates/persistence/src/parquet.rs normalize_path_to_uri), query_files returns catalog-relative paths, and resolve_path_for_datafusion joins them onto the file:// base. DataFusion's ListingTableUrl percent-decodes file:// URLs, so the encoded directory name (e.g. %E5%B8%81...) resolves to a decoded path that does not exist on disk, yielding an empty file listing and 'Schema error: No field named ts_init'.
nt_evidence: crates/persistence/src/backend/catalog.rs: resolve_path_for_datafusion builds file://{base}/{relative} for relative paths when original_uri is file://
crates/persistence/src/parquet.rs: create_object_store_location_from_path -> normalize_path_to_uri converts plain local paths to file:// URIs unconditionally
defect.upstream_status: defect still present on nautechsystems/nautilus_trader master as of 2026-06-12 (resolve_path_for_datafusion unchanged); no config knob avoids it: optimize_file_loading already false, protocol choice cannot prevent file:// normalization, BacktestDataConfig has no explicit-files field
defect.fixed_in_this_repo: projection read-back and logical catalog hashing were fixed for encoded directories on branch fix/cjk-non-ascii-catalog (commit 7d8b6b7b6) via explicit file lists; the failure documented here is the later, NT-internal BacktestNode load stage, which this repo cannot reach without replacing NT's data loading or patching NT
